summary: The FCC should maintain and strengthen the E-Rate program. E-Rate funding enables the district to provide reliable broadband and wireless connectivity that supports teaching, learning, cybersecurity, equitable access, digital assessments, and other essential school operations. Eliminating or restricting E-Rate would increase local costs and divert resources away from students and classrooms.
